implementation_notes: Concepts only, no game files changed. Preserve single-hand grips, physical connections, existing low emission and geometric materials if approved. Blue output depicts vertically staggered paired blades with an open channel; reference image governs final silhouette rather than assuming depth separation alone. Surface shading in illustrations is not a new material requirement. Local particles are concept directions, not verified game effects.

concepts.name: 余烬·错牙
concepts.design: Crimson coral asymmetric offset-cleaver axe. Head is a thick forward-leaning trapezoidal cleaver on LEFT of shaft; nearly straight diagonal outer cutting edge, descending hook-like lower toe, broad clean face. Blade connects to shaft by two short offset solid rectangular necks at different heights, leaving ONE narrow stepped Z-shaped slot between blade and socket. A small blunt angular rear counterweight on right. Whole head is squat and compact, no crown stairs, no circular crescent. Short angular upper haft with a slight forward kink, straight lower octagonal grip, small beveled chisel-shaped pommel. Sparse coral angular flecks near cutting edge.

concepts.name: 流萤·回翎
concepts.design: Emerald mint return-sweep axe. One solid broad forward blade sweeps from upper-left downward and curls inward into a tapered lower beak; large blade face is shaped like a folded flowing ribbon, with ONE elegant continuous longitudinal fold ridge. The upper root of blade curves back over shaft into a short thick blunt fin to right, like a swept wing. One single elongated teardrop opening between curved blade and shaft, not interwoven lattice. Everything connected at thick upper socket; lower curved blade tip stops well above hand. Short gently curved jade neck transitions to straight single palm grip; compact faceted droplet pommel. A few tiny mint curved slivers near inward tip.

concepts.name: 寒汐·叠潮
concepts.design: Petrol blue icy cyan staggered twin-cheek axe. Two broad compact angular blade plates project to LEFT from one robust shaft socket. Front plate is slightly higher and shorter; rear plate is offset in depth and descends into a longer angular cutting toe. Three-quarter view clearly shows two parallel cutting plates separated in depth by a narrow empty air channel; both are strongly joined by one thick solid block at their roots near shaft. Outer edges are angular and convex with two distinct staggered lower tips. This is a squat single-handed axe, not a sword or fork. Clean blue slab faces and cyan bevels, squared straight short shaft and compact cuboid pommel. A few cyan short line particles drift through the channel.

concepts.name: 梦隙·折冕
concepts.design: Violet lilac folded-fan axe. Head flares to LEFT and upward from one compact heavy socket, composed of THREE broad angular solid panels arranged in a fan, subtly offset in depth with crisp raised fold ridges. Outer panel ends collectively create a segmented convex axe cutting edge like an opened architectural fan. Largest upper panel reaches high-left; middle and lower panels end progressively closer to socket. Each panel has substantial body thickness at root and a sharp thin outer edge. All panels overlap and physically connect at common root, no floating parts and no circular ring. Small low angular rear balance fin. Straight short violet shaft with plain octagonal hand grip, small asymmetric diamond wedge pommel. Sparse tiny lavender triangle fragments.
